info.name: 🚦 Dynamic API Rate Limiting Demo - ISA Seminar
info.description:
Postman collection for demonstrating Dynamic API Rate Limiting & Throttling.

Erbil Polytechnic University - Information Systems Architecture (ISA) Seminar.

## Setup
1. Run `php artisan serve` in the project folder
2. Set `base_url` variable to `http://127.0.0.1:8000`
3. Run `php artisan cache:clear` before each demo to reset counters

## Test Accounts
- Normal User: user@example.com / password123 (6 req/min)
- VIP User: vip@example.com / password123 (20 req/min)
- Guest (no token): 3 req/min

item.name: Scenario A - Burst Comparison
item.description:
Compare unprotected vs protected endpoints.

Use Postman Collection Runner with 15 iterations to see the difference:
- Unprotected: all 15 requests succeed (200)
- Protected (Guest): only first 3 succeed, rest get 429

request.description:
No rate limiting applied. All requests will succeed.
Use Collection Runner with 15 iterations - all should return 200.

Rate limited: Guest tier = 3 requests per minute.
Use Collection Runner with 15 iterations:
- First 3 requests: 200 OK
- Requests 4-15: 429 Too Many Requests

item.name: Scenario B - Dynamic Tiers
item.description:
Login as Normal User and VIP User, then test the same endpoint with different tokens.

Run requests in order:
1. Login Normal User → auto-saves user_token
2. Login VIP User → auto-saves vip_token
3. Test products with user_token (6/min limit)
4. Test products with vip_token (20/min limit)
5. Test /me with user_token

item.name: Scenario C - Brute-Force Protection
item.description:
Test brute-force login protection.

Send this request 4+ times rapidly:
- First 3 attempts: 401 Invalid credentials
- 4th attempt: 429 Too Many Requests (blocked!)

request.description:
Simulates a brute-force attack with wrong password.
Rate limited: 3 attempts per minute per email+IP.

Send 4+ times rapidly:
- Attempts 1-3: 401 Invalid credentials
- Attempt 4+: 429 Too many login attempts
